$comment: Landing layout contract. The ACTIVE pack's landing surface reads its layout skeleton — style preset, shell chrome variants, section order and variants — from this file (web/app/src/View/Landing/landingDocument.ts), while section content stays in code, bound by each section's id. Edit this file to re-arrange or re-skin the page; invalid or unknown values fall back to the code config. See docs/landing.md#the-page-is-a-config.
